name: aegis-ui
description: AegisUi local-first engineering cockpit for Apple Silicon.

scripts.install-linux: npm ci && cd src && npm ci && ./../node_modules/.bin/electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty && cd ..
scripts.install-darwin: npm ci && cd src && npm ci && ./../node_modules/.bin/electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty --arch=arm64 --module-dir . && cd ..
scripts.preinstall-windows: npm install --global --production windows-build-tools && npm install --global node-gyp && setx PYTHON "%USERPROFILE%\.windows-build-tools\python27\python.exe"
scripts.install-windows: npm install && cd src && npm install && ..\node_modules\.bin\electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty && cd ..
scripts.prebuild-linux: rsync -a --info=progress2 src/ prebuild-src --exclude node_modules && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install
scripts.prebuild-darwin: node build/build-calendar-helper.js && rsync -a --delete src/ prebuild-src --exclude node_modules && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm ci
scripts.prebuild-windows: mkdir prebuild-src && xcopy src\* prebuild-src\ /E /C /Q /Y && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install
scripts.test: rsync -a --info=progress2 src/ prebuild-src --exclude node_modules && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install && snyk test && cd .. && rm -R prebuild-src
scripts.update-file-icons: git submodule foreach git pull origin master && node file-icons-generator.js

author: Gabriel 'Squared' SAILLARD <gabriel@saillard.dev> (https://gaby.dev)

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: AegisUi uses Automation only when you connect Apple Music to show your current playback.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: AegisUi reads calendar events locally to display your weekly and monthly schedule.
